observation_method: Official publisher page and its Movies and TV metadata hyperlink inspected through the web research tool in this task.
source_description: 2018 Amazon review dataset, Movies and TV product metadata; the publisher explicitly provides this per-category archive for download.
citation: Jianmo Ni, Jiacheng Li, Julian McAuley. Justifying recommendations using distantly-labeled reviews and fine-grained aspects. EMNLP 2019.
scope: This reference establishes the publisher's offered research download. It is not instructor authorization, not raw HTML product snapshots, and does not authorize crawling Amazon.
native_publisher_preflight_note: Native CSE publisher robots request first failed certificate validation, then returned a redirect to a different site's home page after system-trust repair. Its HTML was not crawled by the native collector. Archive-origin robots are checked separately before downloading.
